abstract: <jats:p>Winter wheat cultivar Pindong 34 has both adult-plant resistance (APR) and all-stage resistance (ASR) to stripe rust, which is caused by <jats:italic>Puccinia striiformis</jats:italic> f. sp. <jats:italic>tritici</jats:italic> (<jats:italic>Pst</jats:italic>). To map the quantitative trait loci (QTL) for stripe rust resistance, an F<jats:sub>6−10</jats:sub> recombinant inbred line (RIL) population from a cross of Mingxian 169 × Pingdong 34 was phenotyped for stripe rust response over multiple years in fields under natural infection conditions and with selected <jats:italic>Pst</jats:italic> races under controlled greenhouse conditions, and genotyping was performed with a 90K single nucleotide polymorphism (SNP) array chip. Inclusive composite interval mapping (ICIM) identified 12 APR resistance QTLs and 3 ASR resistance QTLs. Among the 12 APR resistance QTLs, <jats:italic>QYrpd.swust-1BL</jats:italic> (explaining 9.24–13.33% of the phenotypic variation), <jats:italic>QYrpd.swust-3AL.1</jats:italic> (11.41–14.80%), <jats:italic>QYrpd.swust</jats:italic>-<jats:italic>3AL.2</jats:italic> (11.55–16.10%), <jats:italic>QYrpd.swust-6BL</jats:italic> (9.39–12.78%), <jats:italic>QYrpd.swust-6DL</jats:italic> (9.52–16.36%), <jats:italic>QYrpd.swust-7AL</jats:italic> (9.09–17.0%), and <jats:italic>QYrpd.swust-7DL</jats:italic> (8.87–11.38%) were more abundant than in the five tested environments and <jats:italic>QYrpd.swust-1AS</jats:italic> (11.05–12.72%), <jats:italic>QYrpd.swust-1DL</jats:italic> (9.81–13.05%), <jats:italic>QYrpd.swust-2BL.1</jats:italic> (9.69–10.57%), <jats:italic>QYrpd.swust-2BL.2</jats:italic> (10.36–12.97%), and <jats:italic>QYrpd.swust-2BL.3</jats:italic> (9.54–13.15%) were significant in some of the tests. The three ASR resistance QTLs <jats:italic>QYrpd.swust-2AS</jats:italic> (9.69–13.58%), <jats:italic>QYrpd.swust-2BL.4</jats:italic> (9.49–12.07%), and <jats:italic>QYrpd.swust-7AS</jats:italic> (16.16%) were detected based on the reactions in the seedlings tested with the CYR34 <jats:italic>Pst</jats:italic> race. Among the 15 QTLs detected in Pindong 34, the ASR resistance gene <jats:italic>QYrpd.swust-7AS</jats:italic> mapped on the short arm of chromosome 7A was likely similar to the previously reported QTL <jats:italic>Yr61</jats:italic> in the region. The QTLs identified in the present study and their closely linked molecular markers could be useful for developing wheat cultivars with durable resistance to stripe rust.</jats:p>
title: Genome-Wide QTL Mapping for Stripe Rust Resistance in Winter Wheat Pindong 34 Using a 90K SNP Array
